title: Three promises, three written records
instructions: Match each promise to what its written record actually supports. A question may be firm while keeping the source limits. Select three interpretations and check. Guidance selects the same answers and still needs a check.

questions.title: Promise: every community light is already restored.

options.label: The agreement records a staging location and shared hours; it does not verify a completed installation.
A staging agreement proves all lights are working.

questions.title: Promise: a fleet is ready for the gathering.

options.label: The allocation sheet reserves one bus; collection arrangements still need confirmation.
A one-bus reservation proves a fleet is ready.

questions.title: Promise: every catering entry is paid.

options.label: CAT-18 records an outstanding entry; ask for a dated settlement record and a reply.
The unpaid entry proves every other allegation.

messages.selected: Interpretation saved. Read the written records before checking.
messages.guided: Record-based interpretations are selected. Read them, then check.
messages.correction: One or more promises overreach the written record. Distinguish an agreement, a reservation and an outstanding entry. Revise or use guidance, then check again.
messages.ready: Checked. The records support three clear questions, not a verdict on every claim.

supportText: Recorded offers: community rehearsal slot, one-bus collection confirmation and permitted catering-record check. Setup, safe bay and dated settlement checks remain outstanding.
